sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,r.contains_id,r.qty FROM packaging p LEFT JOIN packaging_relations r ON p.id=r.packaging_id ORDER BY p.id,r.contains_id

WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id FROM packaging p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=p.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.contains_id=p.id)), expand(root,node,qty,path) AS (SELECT id,id,1,','||id||',' FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.qty*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM expand e JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id=e.node WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0), leaf AS (SELECT * FROM expand e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node)), totals AS (SELECT root,SUM(qty) total FROM leaf GROUP BY root) SELECT * FROM leaf ORDER BY root,node

WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id FROM packaging p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=p.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.contains_id=p.id)), expand(root,node,qty,path) AS (SELECT id,id,1,','||id||',' FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.qty*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM expand e JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id=e.node WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0), leaf AS (SELECT * FROM expand e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node)), totals AS (SELECT root,SUM(qty) total FROM leaf GROUP BY root) SELECT root,total FROM totals

WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id FROM packaging p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=p.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.contains_id=p.id)), expand(root,node,qty,path) AS (SELECT id,id,1,','||id||',' FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.qty*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM expand e JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id=e.node WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0), leaf AS (SELECT * FROM expand e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node)), totals AS (SELECT root,SUM(qty) total FROM leaf GROUP BY root) SELECT AVG(total*1.0) AS average_total_quantity FROM totals

WITH RECURSIVE e(root,node,q,path) AS (SELECT packaging_id,contains_id,qty,','||packaging_id||','||contains_id||',' FROM packaging_relations UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.q*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM e JOIN packaging_relations r ON e.node=r.packaging_id WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0) SELECT root,node,SUM(q) total,COUNT(*) paths FROM e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node) GROUP BY root,node ORDER BY root,node

WITH RECURSIVE e(root,node,q,path) AS (SELECT packaging_id,contains_id,qty,','||packaging_id||','||contains_id||',' FROM packaging_relations UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.q*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM e JOIN packaging_relations r ON e.node=r.packaging_id WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0) SELECT root,node,q,path FROM e WHERE root IN(531,532,533,534) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node) ORDER BY root,node

WITH RECURSIVE e(root,node,q,path) AS (SELECT packaging_id,contains_id,qty,','||packaging_id||','||contains_id||',' FROM packaging_relations UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.q*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM e JOIN packaging_relations r ON e.node=r.packaging_id WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0) SELECT AVG(q*1.0) path_mean,COUNT(*) path_count,SUM(q) sum_all FROM e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node)

WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id FROM packaging p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=p.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.contains_id=p.id)), expand(root,node,qty,path) AS (SELECT id,id,1,','||id||',' FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT e.root,r.contains_id,e.qty*r.qty,e.path||r.contains_id||',' FROM expand e JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id=e.node WHERE instr(e.path,','||r.contains_id||',')=0), leaf AS (SELECT * FROM expand e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM packaging_relations r WHERE r.packaging_id=e.node)), totals AS (SELECT root,SUM(qty) total FROM leaf GROUP BY root) SELECT ROUND(AVG(qty*1.0),2) mean,COUNT(*) denominator,SUM(qty) numerator FROM (SELECT DISTINCT node,qty FROM leaf)
